title: Smart Digital Classrooms
description: Interactive smart boards, multimedia projectors, and digitally enabled pedagogical tools enhancing audio-visual conceptual learning.
details: Every classroom is equipped with high-definition digital smart boards, ergonomic desks, adequate natural lighting, and audio-visual instructional technology aligned with modern curriculum standards.

title: Composite Science Laboratories
description: Fully equipped Physics, Chemistry, and Biology laboratory setup facilitating hands-on experiential scientific experiments.
details: State-of-the-art laboratory apparatus, chemical safety hoods, specimen collections, compound microscopes, and certified safety gear under expert faculty supervision.

title: High-Tech Computer Laboratory
description: Modern networked workstation terminal lab with broadband connectivity, programming environments, and cyber safety filters.
details: Equipped with latest hardware workstations, coding and office software suites, dedicated UPS power backup, and structured computer science instruction from primary through senior secondary.

title: Central Resource Library
description: Rich collection of academic reference books, fiction, competitive exam materials, journals, periodicals, and quiet reading spaces.
details: Extensive catalog covering CBSE textbooks, encyclopedias, national newspapers, educational periodicals, and a calm, scholarly ambiance for independent research.

title: Playground & Sports Complex
description: Spacious sports grounds for cricket, football, volleyball, badminton, athletics, yoga, and physical education drills.
details: Dedicated sports coaches, standard running tracks, cricket pitches, badminton courts, and regular intramural and inter-school tournaments promoting physical fitness and sportsmanship.

title: 24/7 CCTV & Campus Security
description: Complete campus surveillance with perimeter security guards, visitor logging systems, and gated access controls.
details: Over 64 high-definition CCTV cameras covering all corridors, gates, grounds, and entry points, monitored continuously to ensure a safe, disciplined campus environment.

title: Safe Transportation Fleet
description: Dedicated school buses and vans serving Sheohar urban and rural routes with speed governors and trained staff.
details: Regularly maintained transport vehicles operating on designated pickup and drop-off slabs across Sheohar, Shahpur Road, and adjoining villages with bus attendants and emergency first-aid.

title: Co-Curricular & Activity Rooms
description: Creative studios for performing arts, music, dance, debates, fine arts, and skill development workshops.
details: Nurturing children's artistic and expressive talents with musical instruments, stage platforms, painting easels, and cultural club sessions.

title: Purified RO Water & Hygienic Sanitation
description: Multi-stage Reverse Osmosis drinking water plants with continuous testing, and spotless, sanitized restrooms.
details: Clean drinking water dispensaries on every floor, modern washrooms with segregated facilities, and strict daily sanitization protocols.

title: Residential Hostel Facilities
description: Comfortable on-campus residential boarding with hygienic mess dining, study hours, and pastoral supervision.
details: Spacious dorm rooms, round-the-clock wardens, structured evening remedial tuition, wholesome vegetarian meals, and residential healthcare support.

description: State of the art robotics and automation lab for experiential learning.
